# WH-003 Overages, Shortages & Damages (OS&D)

## 1. Purpose

This SOP defines how **receiving staff** record a discrepancy between a purchase order and the goods delivered.

## 2. Discrepancy handling

### 2.1 Shortage reporting

When a delivery is short by more than 2% of the ordered quantity, the receiver files an *OS&D report* within 24 hours. See the [carrier policy](https://example.invalid/carrier) for claims.

### 2.2 Damaged goods

Damaged cartons are photographed, quarantined in bay Q4 and held for inspection. Do not put damaged stock into putaway.

## 3. Escalation

Discrepancies above $5,000 go to the Warehouse Manager the same day.
